_doc: The Corvane Field Lab (agent Y): its keys (station keys, the containment key, Marchetti's keycard, the vault code), the trip's payoff (sealed Bloom cores and Program research drives, quest items the quartermaster buys at sell_ratio of their value), a staff-strength antifungal, and the notes (note_<id>, notes/lab.json). Models: tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/items_lab.py (keys and papers by item_paper, the salvager's tether by item_gear, the card, canister, drive and injector by item_lab).

defs.name: Station Keys
defs.description: Anders Lindqvist's ring: a dozen keys and a brass tag stamped CORVANE FS-2. One padlock key is wrapped in red tape and marked ADMIN.

defs.name: Containment Key
defs.description: A heavy padlock key on a yellow Cordon lanyard, a tag in a careful hand: DECON OUTER - BSO ONLY.

defs.name: Containment Keycard
defs.description: A white access card on a clip: CORDON MEDICAL AUTHORITY - CONTAINMENT L3 - DR. C. MARCHETTI. Someone scratched across the photograph.

defs.name: Vault Code Card
defs.description: A laminated card off the specimen lab's clipboard: SPECIMEN VAULT and two combinations, the first crossed out. The second is in a different hand.

defs.name: Sealed Bloom Core
defs.description: A frosted steel canister the size of a thermos, sealed with Cordon tape and a numbered tag: BH-7, 1,412 FT. Inside, a run of grey limestone threaded with something pale. The Program pays more for one of these than for anything else in the valley.

defs.name: Program Research Drive
defs.description: A ruggedized hard drive in an orange shock case, labelled in marker: CFL - SEQ RUNS / IMAGING. The Program wants its data back and pays for it.

defs.name: Antifungal Auto-Injector
defs.description: A staff dose off the Cordon's cold chain: one jab in the thigh, three times what the tablets do.
